title: Z-Image gets better framing and faces
summary:
Better-framed Z-Image generations, clearer Gemini tools, fewer reasoning-model request errors, and three more community projects.

Z-Image generation now carries the requested aspect ratio through generation and upscaling. Face restoration is blended with background upscaling when faces are detected, and a safety check returns an error for flagged generated images.

Gemini-large now defaults to `google_search` and `url_context` when callers provide no tools; a custom tools array overrides those defaults. The model table identifies code-execution support, while registry corrections remove tool capabilities from models that do not support them.

Text requests now use the supported temperature of 1 for o1, o3, o4 and GPT-5 series models, including when callers omit the parameter. This avoids unsupported-temperature errors across the affected OpenAI model routes.
